title: Deep Learning Log
lede: A public notebook of what I am actually studying — not a course dump. Each entry is a concept I had to make work on real signals or real tools.

items.title: 1-D CNNs on ECG abnormality detection
items.summary: How far a compact 1-D conv stack can go on noisy wearable ECG before you reach for attention. Focus: class imbalance, patient-wise splits, and not leaking adjacent windows.
notes: Patient-level splits beat random windows; otherwise the model memorizes a person’s baseline.
Morphology artifacts from motion look like PVCs until you condition on signal quality.
Explainability for clinicians means highlighting the beat, not a Grad-CAM theatre.

items.title: SpO2 deterioration as a time-series problem
items.summary: Forecasting a drop is different from classifying a snapshot. Working through horizon choice, calibration, and when a simple lag model beats an LSTM.
notes: A 15-minute horizon is clinically more honest than a 2-hour fantasy.
Missing packets from BLE are a feature of the world, not a preprocessing footnote.
Risk scores need confidence bands a doctor can ignore.

items.title: Multi-biomarker risk scores that can be challenged
items.summary: Combining ECG, SpO2, and vitals into one number is easy. Keeping the contribution of each channel inspectable is the actual research question.
notes: Additive explanations fail when the channels are physically coupled.
A rule layer on top of the net is often what the ward will accept.

items.title: MCP: tool schemas as the real interface
items.summary: Internship work at Zelora. Treating Model Context Protocol servers as typed API products — auth, idempotency, and error shapes included.
notes: If the model can delete, the tool needs a dry-run.
JSON Schema is the prompt. Descriptions are not comments; they are UX.
Logging tool calls is how you debug an agent without arguing with it.

items.title: When transformers help time series — and when they do not
items.summary: Worked through patching, positional encodings, and why a 12-lead hospital ECG is not the same problem as a single-lead patch.
notes: PatchTST-style chunking helped more than going deeper.
On short wearable windows, a CNN still won on latency.

items.title: Embeddings, chunking, and evaluation for vector search
items.summary: MongoDB AI and Vector Search path, applied: a retrieval set is a dataset. If you cannot say what “relevant” means, you do not have RAG.
notes: Chunk by meaning, not by token count alone.
Always keep a frozen eval pack of questions.
